subject: Post-call: Vertex Pay security & retention Qs — proposed MAP and evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@vertexpay.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Vertex Pay security & retention Qs — proposed MAP and evidence

Hi Asha — great to meet you and Tom on the call today. Quick written summary so we have a single record and clear next steps.

Summary of needs you shared
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and a point-in-time report for vendor review (coverage: hosting + control plane).
- Audit / access logs at the request/response level for user sessions (30–90 day retention window; may extend for regulatory reasons).
- Data retention & deletion controls (ability to purge tokens/records on request).
- Evidence of external pen test and remediation timeline for critical findings.
- Contractual DPA language and required security addenda (data residency, subprocessor list).

Pain points / constraints you emphasized
- You need vendor evidence packaged for procurement within 2 weeks to close FYQ4 procurement.
- PCI team will validate log formats and retention; they prefer CSV or NDJSON samples.
- Legal wants a DPA draft they can redline; procurement needs a summary of SLA uptime and escalation path.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP)
1) I’ll send an evidence bundle (SOC 2 excerpt, log sample, pen-test summary, DPA draft) by EOD tomorrow.
2) Your PCI/security reviewer confirms log schema + retention requirement by 9/17.
3) We schedule a 30-min technical follow-up (logs + retention) w/ our infra eng on 9/18 if needed.
4) Legal/procurement review DPA & pricing; aim to finalize redlines by 9/24.

Immediate asks for you
- Can you confirm the minimum retention window you need (30 / 60 / 90 days)?
- Will the PCI scope require token-level request/response payloads, or are metadata-level logs sufficient?

Attachments I will send: SOC2 excerpt, anonymized audit-log sample, DPA draft, pen-test summary.

If that plan looks good I’ll drop the files into the Drive link and follow up here. Thanks again — we’ll prioritize the items procurement needs to hit your 2-week cadence.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II excerpt), audit-log-sample-1.csv (anonymized), DPA_draft_Redwood-VertexPay.docx, pen-test-summary-2025.pdf

From: Asha Menon <asha@vertexpay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@vertexpay.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Vertex Pay security & retention Qs — proposed MAP and evidence

Thanks Jordan — quick clarifications: 
1) Retention: procurement is asking for 90 days as a minimum; PCI team may ask for 180 for certain transaction traces.
2) Logs: for initial procurement review they need per-request timestamp, request_id, authenticated_user_id, request_size, response_status. Not the full PII or payload — metadata-only is fine; tokenized request/response redaction is acceptable.
3) DPA: Legal will want to review subprocessor list and confirm we can require EU data residency for European customers — we’re US-first but want clarity.

If you can send the SOC2 excerpt and log sample tonight that would help us move quickly. Also please include a concise bullet summary (one page max) that procurement can attach to the packet.

— Asha
Asha Menon
CISO, Vertex Pay
asha@vertexpay.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@vertexpay.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@vertexpay.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence bundle + answers to your questions

Hi Asha / Tom — attaching the evidence bundle and a one-page procurement summary as requested. High-level answers below and next-step scheduling.

Answers to clarifications
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention; default short-term retention is 30 days, we can commit to 90 days for audit logs in the vendor contract. For 180-day retention we’ll need a scoped addendum (we’ll include pricing delta).
- Log schema: the sample (audit-log-sample-1.csv) includes timestamp, request_id, user_id (pseudonymous), endpoint, latency_ms, response_status. We redact payloads by default; tokenized request/response can be provided to auditors under NDA only.
- Data residency: our Private deployment can be constrained to EU regions; for Hosted accounts we provide contractual commitments and subprocessor disclosures — DPA contains residency clauses for covered accounts.
- Pen test: summary provided; full report is available to customers under NDA — critical/high findings from 2025 were remediated; see pen-test-summary-2025.pdf.

Attachments in Drive (links below)
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf — SOC 2 Type II excerpt (controls description + auditor opinion).
- audit-log-sample-1.csv — anonymized sample; procurement-friendly format.
- DPA_draft_Redwood-VertexPay.docx — editable draft for Legal.
- pen-test-summary-2025.pdf — high-level findings + remediation notes.

Proposed immediate next steps
- Please confirm retention window (90 confirmed?) by EOD 9/17 so we can include in the MAP.
- If procurement wants the 180-day option, we’ll provide pricing delta by 9/18.
- If you’d like a 30-min technical deep-dive on log formats, I can book Sergio for 9/18 or 9/19 PST.
- I’ll prepare a short procurement summary to include with the packet (one page) — attached.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/vertexpay/evidence/
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7239

Thanks — sending attachments now.

Best,
Jordan
